title: HB2227 (2020 Regular Session): Establishes the offense of unlawful possession of a handgun, which prohibits the possession of a handgun by a minor.

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk dataset (gun-policy Stage 5 LegiScan check); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official house.mo.gov or senate.mo.gov PDF of the version named in note (via LegiScan getBillText)

operative_text:
Section 571.075 (RSMo, new): 2. A person commits the offense of unlawful possession of a handgun if the person is a minor and knowingly possesses a handgun.
Section 571.075 (RSMo, new): 3. The offense of unlawful possession of a handgun is punishable by imposition of a fine not to exceed two hundred dollars, imprisonment in a juvenile detention facility for a period not to exceed ten days, or both.
Section 571.075 (RSMo, new): 1. (3) "Minor", a person who is under nineteen years of age or, if a member of the United States Armed Forces, under eighteen years of age.
